about: When a device may write a synced copy on the account (Notes' marble/later, Reader's marble/reader and discover/seen): sync-guard.js decide(). found: the newest copy's created_at the relays gave (0: none); seenAt: the newest this device has seen (0: none); misses: complete reads in a row that missed it; expires: how long a copy lives on relays (0: for good). A complete read ("reached the account") heard back from more than half of your write relays (EOSE; read relays don't count). retryAfter: the wait after the n-th failure in a row (a new change resets it).

cases.name: a read that missed one of your write relays: wait
never seen a copy, a complete read: write (merged with what's found)
found the copy seen, or newer: write
the copy seen is missing: wait (the relay holding it may be down)
an older copy than seen: wait
the third complete read in a row without it: start again from what your relays have
a seen list past its two weeks: gone, start again
a seen list within its two weeks, missing: wait

complete.name: only read and fast relays answered
